title_zh: 不把申请中的补贴记成预算结余

scenario.label_zh: 虚构剧场预算的资助缺口
scenario.goal_zh: 区分已确认收入与申请中补贴并约定保留缺口另列方案

context_zh: 完全虚构的财务英语课堂练习：Alex 与 Bea 使用剧场预算工作表，不提供个人财务或投资建议。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.text: The theatre’s costs are three thousand, and confirmed ticket income is twenty-two hundred. Why have you written “surplus”?

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: I included the subsidy we’ve applied for and some hoped-for donations.

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.text: Neither is confirmed in the case sheet. We still need to show the eight-hundred gap.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Could a sponsor supplement the ticket income instead?

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.text: We can list that as an option. I don’t want to slash rehearsal time just to hide a funding gap on paper.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Then I’ll remove the surplus claim, keep the gap visible, and put possible funding in a separate column.
